name: Fairmont Breakers Long Beach
insider_take: This oceanfront Art Deco gem sits where Howard Hughes once tested his legendary aircraft, blending aviation history with timeless coastal elegance.
whats_special: Built in 1926, the Fairmont Breakers occupies a prime stretch of Long Beach's coastline with direct beach access and stunning Pacific views. The hotel's classic architecture features original Art Deco details, while its location places you steps from the historic Queen Mary and the bustling Rainbow Harbor entertainment district.
pro_tip: Book an ocean-facing room on the upper floors for unobstructed sunset views over the Pacific, and time your stay during the Long Beach Grand Prix weekend for an unforgettable motorsports spectacle right outside your door.
dont_miss: Take the short walk to explore the permanently docked RMS Queen Mary, one of the world's most famous ocean liners turned floating hotel and museum. The nearby Aquarium of the Pacific offers world-class marine exhibits, while the waterfront Pine Avenue Circle provides excellent dining and nightlife just minutes from the hotel.
pros: Prime oceanfront location with direct beach access
Elegant Fairmont luxury service and amenities
Spacious rooms with panoramic Pacific Ocean views
Close proximity to Long Beach attractions and downtown
cons: Limited on-site parking availability during peak seasons
